status.name: shell.output
status.description: The output lines of the shell surface, without line terminators.

status.name: shell.screen
status.description: The output lines currently visible, the number of lines that fit in the output area, and its scroll position in CSS pixels.

status.name: shell.cwd
status.description: The current directory the shell session last reported, or null before the first report.

status.name: shell.runs
status.description: The number of shell.run commands delivered to the shell session that have not finished.

status.name: shell.history
status.description: The nonblank lines written to the shell session through shell.write, oldest first.

status.name: shell.jobs
status.description: The shell.run commands delivered to the shell session that have not finished, in start order, each with its run id and command text.

commands.name: shell.write
commands.description: Writes text to the shell session: to the running command's input while a command runs, otherwise as the next command.

commands.name: shell.run
commands.description: Runs a command once in the session's current directory without changing the session, and returns its merged output and exit status.

commands.name: shell.interrupt
commands.description: Sends the interrupt signal to the command the session is running and to running shell.run commands.

commands.name: shell.clear
commands.description: Removes all output lines from the shell surface.

dom.name: shell.interrupt
dom.description: The button that interrupts the running command.

dom.name: shell.clear
dom.description: The button that clears the output.
